To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

erbium doped on chip lithium niobate micro ring lasers with high loaded quality factor were realized, which lays a solid foundation for the realization of pulse lasers and frequency combs based on rare earth ion dopped LNOI platform.

the erbium doped microring lasers were demonstrated on the LNOI platform for the first time, and that they exhibited low threshold, stable operation and comb like spectra, which laid the foundation for the realization of pulselaser and frequency combs.
we demonstrated the first erbium doped microlasers based LNOI microrings, which are promising candidates for on chip integrated optical devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel laser source on LNOI platform, which is of great significance to the development of LNOI integrated photonic devices.
a novel type of laser based on erbium-doped LNOI microrings, which is the first demonstration of an erbium-doped laser on a LNOI platform.
the realization of on chip erbium doted LNOI microring lasers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research reported in this Letter has made an important contribution to the field of on chip integrated lasers and optical devices.
we reported the realization on chip LNOIs microlasers based erbium doped ring cavities with a low pump threshold, which lays the groundwork of the realization of on chip integrated optical devices.
we have successfully fabricated and demonstrated erbium doped LiNbO3 microring lasers with a low threshold of 20uW, and comb like spectra spanning from 1500 to 1585nm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the on chip LNOi erbium doped microring lasers were realized and demonstrated a low pump power threshold of ~20 uW, which lays the foundations of the realization of on chip pulsed laser and optical frequency combs.
we have realized a high performance on chip LNOIs laser, which has a great potential in the field of integrated optics.
the erbium doped LiNbO3 microring lasers were demonstrated on a LNOI platform for the first time.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the erbium doped microlasers on LNOI platform can be used as a light source for integrated optical systems, which is an important step towards the realization of integrated LNOI optical systems. (C) 2019 Optical Society of America under the terms of the OSA Open Access Publishing Agreement

we have demonstrated a high quality factor (Q) microring resonator based on erbium (Er3+) doped lithium niobotie (LN) on insulator (INOI).
